mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: unsupported wish: a wish no lookup resolves

summary: At step 13, the first Ctrl-W wizard wish asks for “meat ration.” C objnam.c readobjnam() reaches its wizard unmatched-name tail, gets no terrain wish or object class/type, and returns NULL. zap.c makewish() then prints “Nothing fitting that description exists in the game.” and retries; JS instead throws UnsupportedWishError (“a wish no lookup resolves”) from readobjnam(), stopping the segment at 13/76. The actionable first owner is the readobjnam() no-match return, with makewish()’s return-valued failed-wish retry required in the same behavior chain. The later C recipe reaches a tripe-ration throw that Hachi catches and eats at step 73 through dothrow.c to dog.c tamedog() and dogmove.c dog_eat(); that downstream event is not the first mismatch and is not reached by JS before the wish retry is implemented.

source.branch: In wizard mode, readobjnam() reaches wiztrap after no object-name lookup succeeds. For the entered “meat ration,” wizterrainwish() returns null, d.bp does not select the polearm or hammer fallback, and d.oclass remains empty; C returns NULL at objnam.c:4992-4993. The JS equivalent throws at that boundary. The active caller zap.c makewish() consumes NULL at 6361-6364 by printing the no-match message, incrementing tries, and retrying the wish prompt.
callers: C cmd.c:2000 maps Ctrl-W (C('w')) to wiz_wish(); wizcmds.c:wiz_wish() calls zap.c:makewish() at 38; zap.c:makewish() calls objnam.c:readobjnam() and branches on its nullable return at 6360-6364.
JS command dispatch reaches js/wizcmds.js:wiz_wish(), then js/zap.js:makewish(), then js/objnam_readobjnam.js:readobjnam(); the current no-match throw escapes before the makewish retry can run.
dependencies: zap.c:makewish() is a required return-valued caller dependency: its source retry prints the failed-wish text and asks again while tries < MAXWISHTRY (5). js/zap.js:makewish() currently marks this null-return path as an explicit UnsupportedWishError boundary at lines 2008-2009.

wizcmds.c:wiz_wish() temporarily clears flags.verbose around makewish(), restores it, and then calls encumber_msg(); preserve that active wrapper while retrying. The C command route is the wizard-only Ctrl-W row in cmd.c:2000.

Downstream intended event only: after a valid tripe-ration wish and throw, dothrow.c:throwit() calls tamedog() (dothrow.c:2269); dog.c:tamedog() places the caught food and calls dogmove.c:dog_eat() at dog.c:1200-1212. The C recording shows “Hachi catches the tripe ration. Hachi eats a tripe ration.” at step 73. This is beyond the first JS stop.

evidence: The selected provenance is the v5 queue entry for synthetic/v5/samurai-pet-ration-eating: manifest challenges/manifests/v5.json (SHA-256 5e4430fbd724fe91720f898c02e6f25f9d98e884fa31bd696ca1a63e87abf150), recording challenges/cases/v5/samurai-pet-ration-eating.session.json (SHA-256 719edf6f87e6d47c9c59b0cbfd8a418269fb55e34f5dfbc93500b61dd472954c), and saved evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260926040211-v5.json at d273b8936ba6746f4fa8287bf41668a9776c927c. The queue reports 63 remaining screens of 76, 13/76 screens and cursors matched, 2699/2926 RNG calls matched, and a stop at step 13.

The immutable recipe challenges/cases/v5/samurai-pet-ration-eating.recipe.session.json begins with Ctrl-W, “meat ration”, Enter. In the C recording, step 13 is Enter and its screen begins “Nothing fitting that description exists in the game.--More--”; step 14 is Space and the screen becomes “For what do you wish (enter 'help' for assistance)?”, demonstrating that C reports a failed wish and continues the same makewish call.

Upstream objnam.c:4910-4993 documents and implements the null result for a failed lookup: the wizard wiztrap branch offers the text to wizterrainwish(), applies the polearm/hammer fallbacks, then returns NULL when d.oclass remains unset. Upstream zap.c:6360-6364 consumes that return by printing the exact recorded message and retrying while tries is below MAXWISHTRY (defined as 5 at zap.c:6160).

At the examined JS source, js/objnam_readobjnam.js:2000-2011 throws UnsupportedWishError after wizterrainwish() declines the text, instead of returning null. js/zap.js:2007-2009 has the corresponding makewish null/retry path explicitly unported and throws if it receives null. This accounts for the saved evaluation stop before the C retry screen.

The same C recording later shows the intended pet event at step 73 after the tripe-ration throw. Upstream dothrow.c:2269 -> dog.c:tamedog() (1200-1212) -> dogmove.c:dog_eat() identifies that as a later path; it cannot explain the first stop at step 13.
